label: first-three-season fWAR from the frozen vintage (fwar_vintage.season_totals), a window season with no row counts 0 (bust-inclusive among debuts)
aging: aging_v3.fitted(corpus, T - 1) per fold, aging v2 component curves (U3, U6); no served curves file exists, so the point-in-time fit stands in for 'as served'
missing_input_rule: a missing level-0 input enters at the training mean (0 after standardization) with a 0/1 missing indicator column
playing_time_rule: the training cohorts' mean pooled first-three-season PA (hitters) or BF and games (pitchers by SP and RP), evenly over the three seasons; the scored player's own exposure is never read
assembly: proj_components.hitter_heads / pitcher_heads at season_constants(T - 1) with the feed lgwOBA as the wOBA anchor, PF 1.0, no framing charge, baserunning and fielding at 0 runs (not projected), positional runs from the as-of position, pitcher FIP from the projected K%, BB% and HR per BF with HBP at 0
survivorship: Debuts only: every number is accuracy among players who reached the majors, conditional on reaching MLB, not accuracy over all prospects.
frames: Development cohorts 2017 to 2021 only (spent, gate 0.1). Holdout H (2022 to 2024) and R-VM (2025 and later) are never read here. No statistic is cut by consensus-FV cell.
decides: nothing: the development read re-reads spent cohorts; only holdout H (TL_17) carries a verdict
